title: Car Rent
description: Premium sedan and luxury car rentals for city tours, airport transfers, and business travel.
details: We offer a wide range of well-maintained cars including luxury sedans and budget-friendly options. All rentals come with professional, well-trained drivers to ensure your comfort and safety.

title: SUV Rent
description: Comfortable and spacious SUV rentals for family trips and long-distance highway travel.
details: Choose from our premium SUVs like Toyota Fortuner or Suzuki Brezza for a balanced mix of luxury and performance. Ideal for small groups looking for extra comfort.

title: Jeep Rent
description: Powerful 4x4 Jeep rentals for off-road adventures and navigating the diverse terrains of Nepal.
details: Our 4WD Jeeps like Scorpio and Land Cruisers are perfect for rough roads, mountain trips, and remote village explorations. Experience power and stability on any trail.

title: Hiace Rent
description: Reliable Toyota Hiace rentals for medium-sized groups and tourist operations.
details: Our Hiace fleet is the gold standard for tourist groups. Spacious seating, dual AC, and high-roof models ensure everyone travels in comfort.

title: Mini Bus Rent
description: Comfortable 18-25 seater mini buses for medium-sized groups and corporate outings.
details: Our mini buses are perfect for 18-25 passengers. They offer a balance of maneuverability and group comfort, making them ideal for narrow valley roads and city tours.

title: SUTLEJ BUS
description: Spacious 35-41 seater luxury Sutlej and tourist buses for large groups and long-distance travel.
details: For groups of 35-41 people, our luxury tourist buses (including Sutlej models) provide maximum comfort with reclining seats, wide windows, and advanced suspension systems.

title: Premium Fleet
description: Our most exclusive selection of high-end vehicles, including luxury SUVs and executive buses.
details: For those who demand the best. Our premium fleet features the latest models with superior comfort, advanced safety features, and elite styling for VIP travel.
